title: 场景卡提示词把主从关系写成「查找」：project 卡让智能体建错关系类型
body:
epic:#5027#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMUfmNYTem26rXLFUf

Filing gate: ② seat-found, from the objectstack-ai/cloud#5080 itemisation (comment https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/5080#issuecomment-7207375342, recordings `/mnt/project-files/trials/cloud-5031/runs.tgz`, the nine `g1d-afterbb-*` door builds). Premises re-checked by that thread on objectstack `origin/main` ce4d8c7d.
Parent: objectstack-ai/cloud#5027 (M2 Build line: median 101/112 = 90.2%, the line is 107/112).
Grading: area:ai · domain:devx · Bug · p2 · size XS · reach: every scenario round on a card tagged `records-forms.master-detail-inline-edit`.
Dedupe: searched `structureLines Lookups master_detail`: none.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：评测给智能体的需求描述里，project 卡把「任务属于项目」写在「查找」这一行，而评分要求的是主从关系。智能体照着写了查找，三次都丢分。
- 影响：每次 2 分，共 6 分，中位数 +2。是卡片写法的问题，不是智能体的问题。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What to do
1. `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/prompts.ts` `structureLines()`: on a card carrying `records-forms.master-detail-inline-edit`, name the relationship as master-detail (e.g. "Master-detail: task.project → project (tasks are entered inline on the project)") instead of listing it under "Lookups". Keep every other card's prompt byte-identical (show the prompt diff for all cards in the PR).
2. Test: the project card's prompt names the master-detail; a card without the tag is unchanged.
